exposure: Doppler velocimetry results (pulsatility index, resistivity indices, SD ratios)
cohort: 80 women with singleton pregnancies and IUGR fetuses delivered by Cesarean section.
finding: Abnormal Doppler velocimetry in IUGR fetuses is associated with acidosis, hypoxemia, and hypercapnia in newborns.
followup_time: Immediately after birth (umbilical cord blood sampling)
